name: My Room
title: 🌱 My Room
description: Learn what a room is: floor, walls, ceiling, door, and windows!

steps.body: Hello friend! A room has walls, a floor under your feet, and a ceiling above you! 🏠

steps.prompt: Can you tap on the floor?
Where is the door to go outside?
Tap on the window where sunlight comes in!

name: Furniture Friends
title: 🪑 Furniture Friends
description: Meet chairs, tables, beds, and sofas! Discover what each is used for.

steps.body: A chair is for sitting! A bed is for dreaming! Let's explore them! 🛋️

steps.prompt: Find the chair in the room!
Can you put the chair near the table?
steps.success_message: Great teamwork! Now we can sit and eat! 🍽️

name: Color World
title: 🎨 Color World
description: Explore warm, cool, bright and cozy colors to make walls and furniture happy!

steps.body: Colors change how a room feels! Blue is calm like the sky, and yellow is bright like the sun! ☀️

steps.prompt: Make the wall blue like the ocean!
Pick your favorite happy color for the chair!

name: Shapes & Space
title: 🔷 Shapes & Space
description: Circles, rectangles, near, far, inside, and outside! Shapes make furniture.

steps.body: A table is shaped like a rectangle! Rugs can be soft circles! 🔷

steps.prompt: Place the bed near the wall so it feels safe and cozy!

name: Smart Space
title: 📐 Smart Space
description: Walking paths, room size, and making sure nothing blocks the door!

steps.body: We need space to walk! If furniture is in front of the door, people can't enter! 🚶

steps.prompt: Move the chair away from the door so it opens freely!
steps.success_message: Awesome! Now we have plenty of walking space! 🚪✨

name: My First Room Design
title: 🏠 My First Room Design
description: Build your very own complete bedroom, study, or living room!

steps.body: You're a real designer now! Place a bed, a table, and a lamp in your new room! 🌟

steps.prompt: Arrange the 3 pieces and pick matching colors!
steps.success_message: Hooray! You built your first complete room! 🏆

name: Design Explorer
title: 💡 Design Explorer
description: Balance, focal points, cozy lighting, and real materials like wood and fabric!

steps.body: Warm lights feel like bedtime stories! Wood feels natural and strong! 🪵💡

steps.prompt: Change the floor to natural warm wood!
steps.success_message: Look how warm and inviting the room is! 🪵

name: Floor Plan Explorer
title: 🗺️ Floor Plan Explorer
description: A floor plan is a map of a room seen from above! Draw walls and doors.

steps.body: Bird's-eye view! A floor plan is a map that shows where walls and furniture go from above! 🦅

steps.prompt: Draw a rectangular room boundary on the 2D grid!
steps.success_message: Incredible! You made a 2D floor plan! 🗺️

name: 2D to 3D Magic
title: 🌍 2D to 3D Magic
description: Watch the magic! The computer takes your flat map and builds real 3D walls and furniture!

steps.body: 3, 2, 1... Magic! The AI turns your flat paper map into a full 3D room you can explore! 🚀

steps.prompt: Tap 'Turn into 3D' to bring your room to life!
steps.success_message: WOW! Your drawing became a real 3D room! 🏰✨

name: Young Designer
title: 👑 Young Designer
description: You graduated! Design your ultimate dream room with full 3D, voice, AI, and colors!

steps.body: Congratulations, Master Designer! 👑 Combine everything you learned to build your dream room!

steps.prompt: Create your ultimate room and save your graduation masterpiece!
steps.success_message: 🎉 YOU DID IT! You are a certified DesignVerse Young Interior Designer! 🏆🏅
